overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted academic and professional presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. Content consistently focuses on computational social science, disinformation research, software tools (CooRnet), grants, and academic hiring, yielding high engagement rates driven by strong domain-specific authority.

contentThemes.description: Updates on newly published papers, grants awarded, and upcoming conference presentations on disinformation and coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Product updates and methodological discussions regarding computational social science tools like CooRnet.
Job openings for postdoctoral researchers and research opportunities for prospective PhD students.

recommendations: Cross-promote tool releases like CooRnet on LinkedIn to leverage a larger professional audience.
Include call-to-action questions or links on Mastodon posts to increase discussion and repost rates.
Maintain high publishing frequency on Bluesky where engagement rates per follower are highest.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest engagement rate relative to follower count, driven heavily by reposts on publication updates and PhD opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a focused niche audience (aoir.social) responding well to open-source software updates and methodological debates.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest raw interaction counts (likes/comments), making it ideal for institutional announcements, hiring, and grant awards.
